projectTitle: notehub-py: Python client for the Blues Notehub API
description: notehub-py, published on PyPI as notehub-py and imported as notehub_py, is the Python client library for the Blues Notehub REST API at https://api.notefile.net, generated from the Notehub OpenAPI specification. It provides synchronous API classes and pydantic models for Notehub projects, devices, fleets, events, routes, environment variables, firmware updates, monitors, jobs, and usage data.
rules: Install with pip install notehub-py and import the package as notehub_py, with an underscore.

Authorize Notehub API requests to https://api.notefile.net with an Authorization: Bearer header carrying a Notehub personal access token or an OAuth bearer token. In notehub-py, pass it as notehub_py.Configuration(access_token=token).

Open a client with `with notehub_py.ApiClient(configuration) as api_client:` and pass it to an API class such as notehub_py.DeviceApi(api_client), notehub_py.ProjectApi(api_client), or notehub_py.EventApi(api_client).

notehub-py methods are synchronous and snake_case. Pass required path parameters positionally and optional ones as keyword arguments, e.g. get_devices(project_or_product_uid, page_size=50, page_num=1). HTTP errors raise notehub_py.ApiException.

Devices, Notes, Notefiles, and device environment variables are in DeviceApi; fleets, products, firmware, DFU, and project environment variables are in ProjectApi; events are in EventApi; routes are in RouteApi.

Paged methods such as get_devices take page_size and page_num and return has_more. To read many events, call EventApi.get_events_by_cursor and pass each response's next_cursor as the cursor argument of the next call.

Copy Api class, method, parameter, and model names exactly from this SDK's src/docs files or the Notehub API reference (https://dev.blues.io/api-reference/notehub-api/); do not invent methods, parameters, or response fields.
